purpose: Establish, rather than verify, the MIDI tick-zero to exported WAV sample mapping using a bounded timing-only diagnostic.

control.role: already-consumed authenticated control; timing-only, never an acoustic holdout

timeline.shift_rule: Add each pre-registered delta to NoteOn, NoteOff and EOT; retain tempo and initial pedal reset at tick zero.

capture_route: GUI owned-session with main-session Windows-MCP per-action approval; no headless RPC substitute
state_baseline: authenticated Standard FXP, 215 numeric parameters, A4=440, private session and protected user state
observations: WAV sample rate, channels, bit depth and frame count
export duration and its difference from the SMF timeline
linearity of the inferred offset across the 0.0 / 0.5 / 1.0 second shifts

acceptance.rounding: nonnegative half-away-from-zero; report integer half-open intervals
insufficient_evidence: successful B fit or spectral comparison
acceptance.failure_disposition: origin_not_authenticated; stop the bounded attempt; no retry, replacement case, threshold or shift tuning

avoided_known_gaps: Uses only the already-consumed n69-v70 control; it does not open a new acoustic holdout.
Does not touch n88, n67, n29 or any pitch reserved for the new formal matrix.
Does not use standard trial-muted keys 30/32/34/73/75/78/80/82 or observed native-muted keys 42/44/46/85/87/90/92/94.
Does not extend the formal validation matrix or produce acoustic evaluation samples.

authorization.note: This file registers the plan only. Execution requires a separate explicit approval after the go/no-go revision is reviewed.

go_no_go_revision: The former plan required independent binding capability before capture, which is circular. This bounded diagnostic is the experiment that establishes the mapping; it may start only after separate authorization and must stop on any identity, protection, parameter, deadline or mapping failure.
